response.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT ts, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM b), a AS (SELECT ts, cnt, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM a WHERE share > avg_share

assumptions.assumption: Orders with NULL timespan form one bucket (GROUP BY puts NULLs together); empty-string values, if any, would be a separate bucket.
The 'average of all bucket shares' is computed over all buckets before filtering, and the output's average share and average excess are over the kept buckets only.
The summary row is empty if no bucket exceeds the average, which happens only when all shares are equal.
